name: Boutique ecommerce
category: Small catalog, filters, and a fictional cart
summary: A scannable product grid with filters and a cart. Checkout collects a fictional order and charges nothing.

fidelity.notes: Standard keeps product prices and filters clearer than full costume. Costume remains available from the switcher.

layouts: Filter bar above a wrapping product grid.
Prices and names stay in the same card anatomy in every era.

responsive.behavior: One column of products below 800px. Two columns from 800px. Three when the row fits.

priorities: Product name and price are the scan line.
Display face only in the masthead.

spacing.priority: Even card gaps. Do not let ornament consume the price.

interactions: Category select and in-stock checkbox filter the grid.
Checkout dialog confirms a fictional order.
accessibility: Filter select and checkbox have visible labels.
Cart count is a live region.

use: Era chrome on cards and buttons.
Hero hooks so a costume switch still has a stage or panel.

eraDeviations.note: Masthead includes stage and panel hooks. Page CSS may shorten the hero so the first products stay visible.
Organic hero uses the canonical .ew-hero__stage; keep forms unornamented.

customization: Era and band switch on the root.
